projects.name: Monte Carlo Simulation of Somatic Twist in Ancient Marine Worms
projects.summary: Research Purpose: run Monte Carlo simulation to recreate evolutionary events inside a computer and see how the first digital worm evolves in silico to become the ‘first fish’ with a dorsoventrally inverted body plan after a somatic twist.
